name: FS2Rust Filesystem, NTFS & Data Workstation
description: 24-tool pure-Rust filesystem search, NTFS/disk/ETW telemetry, and structured data utility suite with dual Win32/Iced GUIs, CLI, Merkle custody reports, and policy-gated MCP server.
majorCapabilities: 6 filesystem search, timestamp/attribute, folder size report, [MS-SHLLINK] .lnk, and streaming multi-hash tools (4 gated mutating actions)

11 NTFS & disk telemetry tools covering drive letters, IOCTL disk counters, ETW Kernel-File activity/errors, ReadDirectoryChangesW, process I/O, ATA/NVMe S.M.A.R.T., ADS, reparse/hardlinks, Property System, and $UsnJrnl (4 gated mutating actions)
7 pure-Rust structured data tools: CSV/TSV viewer, table diff, tabular query evaluator, JPEG/TIFF EXIF parser, template codegen, HTML-to-text, and contact book reader
Native Win32 (WinSafe) & Iced 0.14 dual GUIs, 7-format guap-export with CSV formula neutralization + SHA-256/512 Merkle custody manifests
Policy-gated MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 (2024-11-05) stdio server enforcing ReadOnlyOnly default and -32003 refusal on unconfirmed mutations

tools.summary: Enumerate NTFS Alternate Data Streams via FindFirstStreamW/FindNextStreamW or offline $MFT records
Count per-application read/write operations and byte transfer rates using GetProcessIoCounters
Preview bulk file/folder timestamp and attribute changes (ReadOnly dry-run)
Query Windows physical/logical disk read/write counters and queue depth via IOCTL_DISK_PERFORMANCE
Read ATA S.M.A.R.T. attributes/thresholds and NVMe Health Log Page 0x02 telemetry from physical drives
Enumerate logical drives, volume GUIDs, capacities, DOS targets, and HKLM\SYSTEM\MountedDevices mappings
Detect failed file open/read/write/delete operations via ETW Kernel-File OperationEnd non-zero NTSTATUS codes
Monitor real-time file system read/write/open/close activity via Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-File ETW
Monitor file/folder creations, deletions, modifications, and renames via ReadDirectoryChangesW or snapshot diff
Preview bottom-up folder timestamp updates from newest child files (ReadOnly)
Compute directory logical size, allocated/compressed size on disk, file/subfolder counts, and parent percentage
Pure-Rust contact book reader for vCard (.vcf), LDIF (.ldif), and contact CSV files
Dynamic CSV/TSV viewer with auto-delimiter, encoding detection, and typed column inference
Pure-Rust JPEG APP1 and TIFF IFD0/Exif/GPS/Interop/IFD1 EXIF metadata parser
Pure-Rust HTML-to-text extractor preserving headings, lists, tables, preformatted blocks, and link footnotes
Evaluate tabular queries (columns, where, sort, top) and format outputs
Template-based snippet generator from regex captures, CSV, JSON, or TableData
Compare two CSV/TSV/JSONL/TableData inputs by key columns or row position
Compute MD5, SHA1, SHA256, SHA512, and CRC32 in a single streaming read pass and group identical files
Inspect NTFS symbolic links, directory junctions, reparse points, and hardlinks
Read Windows Property System metadata via SHGetPropertyStoreFromParsingName / IPropertyStore
Search files and directories with wildcards, size/time/attribute filters, text/regex/binary content grep, and SHA-256 duplicate grouping
Parse Windows [MS-SHLLINK] .lnk shortcuts and detect broken targets
Query and read NTFS Change Journal ($UsnJrnl:$J) USN_RECORD_V2/V3 records
Delete a named NTFS Alternate Data Stream (refuses default ::$DATA stream)
Apply bulk timestamp and attribute changes to target files and folders
Assign a volume GUID to a drive letter or NTFS mount-point directory (SetVolumeMountPointW)
Remove a drive letter or NTFS mount-point mapping (DeleteVolumeMountPointW)
Update folder timestamps bottom-up to match their newest child files
Set a Windows Property System canonical property on a file via IPropertyStore (GPS_READWRITE)
Delete Windows .lnk shortcuts (guarded by only_if_broken = true by default)
Update the target path, working directory, or arguments inside a Windows .lnk shortcut
